name: Melody Hawkins
source:
Melody is the daughter of [url=https://vndb.org/c56920]Robin[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c56919]Sally[/url].

[spoiler]One year prior to the game's events, Melody tried to commit suicide, but ultimately failed to do so. She suffers from depression which partially stems from her relationship issues with her family. [url=https://vndb.org/c55454]Bell[/url] exploited her weakness and possessed Melody's body in order to seduce Robin.[/spoiler]
